title: A Medieval Cipher You Can Run With Dice #shorts
description:
"No medieval cipher looks like the Voynich manuscript" was the argument. In 2025 Michael Greshko built one that does: the Naibbe cipher, using dice and playing cards. It doesn't solve the book, but it moved my meter.

Full investigation on the channel: Is the Voynich Manuscript Gibberish? I'm 65% Sure It Isn't

Source: Greshko, M. (2025), Cryptologia, doi:10.1080/01611194.2025.2566408. Images: Beinecke Library, Yale (public domain).

Narration and visuals are AI-generated.
